meta.title: Intellisense suggestion in Typescript after prop with literal string type
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#52676 (Exclude literal completions after closing quote and JSX attribute location), 0e357f510b, 2023-02-28; git tag --contains: first in v5.1-beta / v5.1.3
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@5.0.4 (2023-04-07) and typescript@5.1.3 (2023-06-01), both behind typescript-language-server@3.3.2 (the latest wrapper release before 5.1.3), started with the pinned tsserver.js; the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session.
meta.notes: Same fix PR as tsserver-52675 (the general form of this report). The fix stops offering literal completions at a JSX attribute location, so a post-fix list without the literal is 'absent' (missing: absent).

settings_note: The issue's tsconfig.json is used verbatim (jsx preserve, strict, isolatedModules); no client settings are named.

repro.steps: Open index.tsx. Go to the empty line after the age prop of the Person element (line 8) and request completions (ctrl+space). Reported: the list offers the literal values of the age prop entered above (middle, old, young) instead of the remaining props such as height; accepting one inserts a bare string literal into the JSX element, which is invalid JSX. Probe: accept the offered literal "old"; the edited text must not have a parse error the original did not have. No such item offered counts as absent.
